passages.context: The Liturgical Year continuation's direct theological reception of the Tenth Sunday after Pentecost Postcommunion, printed immediately after the Communion antiphon and immediately before the Latin and English Postcommunion on page 271. Read from PDF page 292 rendered at 160 dpi and visually checked against the hashed facsimile. It attributes sacramental repair and the preservation and increase of spiritual treasure to continuing divine aid; it does not establish the prayer's lexical meaning, authorship, date, or original calendar assignment.

work.author: Prosper Guéranger and continuators
work.description: The historical and theological commentary on the Roman liturgical year begun by Prosper Guéranger and continued after his death. English editions translate the French series; the registered Time after Pentecost II volume identifies itself as a Continuation without naming its writer in the checked preface. Its interpretations are reception witnesses rather than promulgating liturgical sources.
